landing.title: Build mecha from the runner to the display shelf.
landing.lead: Clip parts with nippers, sand the gate marks, then assemble by the manual. No timer, no score, no parts lost under the desk.

1.d: The runner lands on your workbench.

2.d: Click gates with the nipper until the part is free.

3.d: Rub the gate nubs away with sandpaper.

4.d: Drag parts onto their joints, step by step.

5.d: Color each part, place stickers where you like.

6.d: Set the joints, take a photo, shelve it.

landing.footer: Every mecha design here is original, not an official Gundam or other brand product.

hint.hand: Drag a free part onto the yellow outline. Click it to lift it up and look closer.
hint.nipper: Nipper in hand: point at a gate (the small connector) and click to cut. Right-click or Esc puts it down.
hint.sand: Sandpaper in hand: lift a free part (with Hand), then rub its nubs back and forth until flush.
hint.brush: Brush in hand: pick a colour below, then click a part to paint it.
hint.decal: Decal sheet in hand: pick a sticker, then click a part surface to apply it. Click an existing sticker to adjust it.

book.tip: Cut all of a part’s gates, sand its nubs while you can still reach them, then fit it to the yellow outline.
